verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a card-issuing API platform, and such a platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only REST APIs, browser widgets, sandbox simulations and an official MCP server. None of it mentions a command-line tool, and MCP-server evidence belongs to a different story and does not transfer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
